title: LiveOpenreSlotBindResult
description: live.openre-slot-bind-result@1: the answer of POST /internal/openre/slots: the Live slot (managed_stream_id) now ingested by OpenRestream for that stream, the channel it shows on, and created false when the slot already existed. Refusals are problem bodies: 400 (bad body), 409 live.no_account (no Live account for that subject yet), 409 live.slot_taken (the stream is bound to another person's slot).
